manifest.name: Bubble Critter Garden
manifest.description: Rescue one tiny critter at a time in a pastel 3D bubble shooter. Ten levels, mixed pastel hex rows, seven power-ups, feeding and earned bombs. Two missed matches add a row. Right-click swaps current and next colors. Bigger, sharp text, mouse/touch play, original music and weekly scores. Single-player.

credits.work: Original 3D art, procedural textures, music, sound effects and game code
